title: Friend View
description:
Friend View lets you follow your friends' play in Slay the Spire 2 co-op through a dedicated read-only demo view. Watch their hand, energy, health, powers, relics, cursor, animated card selection and a native-art targeting arrow without elastic hover animations. Keep watching a living teammate after your own character dies, and switch between friends in larger co-op parties.

[h2]Beyond combat[/h2]
Observe post-combat rewards and available card rewards. Demo is limited to combat and post-combat rewards; events, dialogue, predictions and other activities are not supported. Use the native upgrade-preview checkbox to inspect upgraded versions of all offered reward cards without changing real cards.

[h2]Simple controls[/h2]
In combat and post-combat rewards, click the eye beside a teammate's status in the player list. The active eye turns green. Click it again or press Esc to smoothly return to your own view.

When viewing card rewards, the only exit eye is to the right of the cards. Exit first to choose another friend in the player list.

[h2]Observation, not control[/h2]
You cannot play your friend's cards, buy their items, choose event options or claim rewards while observing. Your native End Turn button still ends your own turn. Exit demo to make your own choices. Card effects, combat rules and the save format are unchanged.

[h2]Supported screens and privacy[/h2]
Demo is unavailable in events, dialogue, crystal-sphere predictions, shops (including the fake merchant), rest sites, relic choices including Ancient offers, and all other non-combat activities. Unsupported screens close the view automatically. Outside combat, players already observing someone else cannot themselves be observed.

Rewards are rendered locally from installed game assets and compact reward-state updates, only while someone is watching. Activity scenes are not transmitted. There is no screen-image streaming or desktop capture. Unchanged elements are not repeatedly transmitted. Decorative GPU effects are not mirrored. Opening a teammate's map keeps the previous observed activity on screen. The player list remains your local interface. The native top bar shows the observed player's portrait, health, gold, potions and deck count. Its map and settings buttons open your own local screens; its deck button opens your teammate's deck.

[h2]Installation[/h2]
Every lobby member must use matching game and Friend View versions. Enable it through the built-in mod loader. No additional loader or library is required.

[h2]Your normal progress[/h2]
When Friend View is the only successfully loaded cosmetic mod, the game uses your normal profile. With any other mod or loading error, the separate modded profile remains in use. This choice stays fixed until restart. Friend View does not copy, merge or delete save files; the game saves the selected profile normally. The MODDED indicator remains visible.

[h2]Controller support[/h2]
Select a teammate's player-list row using native navigation, then press the focused-selection action (default Xbox A). Cancel (B) exits. Confirm (Y) toggles reward-card upgrade previews; in combat it still ends YOUR turn. Native button hints follow the controller type and in-game remapping.
